title: Cement imports in El Salvador reach highest level in 30 years
summary: Cement imports in El Salvador reach highest level in 30 years
body_markdown: **El Salvador:** Cement imports in El Salvador have reached their highest level in three decades during the first half of 2026, according to local press, which cited the latest data from the Central Reserve Bank. The volume of purchases during this period reached 389,330t, an increase of 35% year-on-year, the largest volume recorded since 1994. China emerged as the leading supplier, representing 26% of the total, followed by Vietnam, Honduras and Guatemala.
